checks.detail: Final contract observations must match the recorded agent, policy, proposal and open agreement.
Funding is available only for an open job.
Proposal expiry is checked again before real funding.
The proposal must match the current active manifest.
Execution policy must be active and unexpired.
The publication-based deadline must allow execution.
The offer must meet the registered agent price floor.
The agreed price cannot exceed the job budget.
Acceptance criterion: The recommendation addresses the brief.
Available client funds must cover escrow; the testnet estimate also reserves 0.01 NEAR for gas.
Available creator performance bond must cover this job.
The contract must preserve exit reserves and sponsor storage for the new obligation.
The creator authorizes a source-extractor child within its spending ceiling.
The child is paid from the creator free balance, independently of client escrow.
The specialist needs its own available performance collateral.
The specialist and its execution policy must be active.
All selected execution grants must remain active. Revocation stops future execution.
